subject: [PATCH 43/60] mm/page_alloc: fall back when a bind policy's nodes become private

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses memory hotplug issues in the Linux kernel's page allocation mechanism. Specifically, it handles cases where a bind policy's nodes become private after memory removal. The patch introduces changes to relax_private_alloc() to treat nodemasks naming private nodes as private requests, ensuring proper allocation from common memory when necessary.
